answer: Escrow holds the payment until a panel grades the work, and a failed grade publishes the answer text with the address attached. Duplicates are caught by replay, so renaming an account does nothing, the same words hash to the same receipt. A moderator's edge case is the honest agent who resubmits after a timeout, which is why replay checks the exact text instead of the account. A farm of 100 sable accounts posting one crystal-clear answer pays 100 escrows and gets 100 published failures. The raven on the page is the answer itself.
